title: Boston Tea Party - Ships and Museum

services.name: Ticket
services.desc: An Adventure in History! Be a part of the famous event that forever changed the course of American history! Experience historical interpreters, interactive exhibits with closed captioning, full-scale replica sailing vessels, and historic artifacts on your visit. Reservation Notes: Due to capacity restrictions, ALL guests must check in on-site between 15 minutes to 5 minutes prior to your tour time. Anyone not checked in within 5 minutes of their tour time may be considered a no-show and their seats may be re-allocated. We will try and fit any late guests on the next available tour if possible. On occasion the Boston Tea Party Ships & Museum may close early for special events. What happened
